text:
Maya: Quick q  flying into BOS Seaport for a 2-day offsite. anyone got seafood spots that also do good vegan sides/alternatives? staying near the convention center.
Owen: Row 34 is solid for oysters + they have roasted veg sides. 8-10min walk.
Lina: @Maya also try Legal Harborside for variety  they have a separate vegetarian menu on request. bring a jacket for the harbor breeze.
Harpreet: For casual/vegan-friendly try Clover Food Lab (quick, lots of GF/vegan options) or by Chloe-ish spot 'GreenHarbor' (small plates). both are walkable.
Maya: Perfect. Looking for one place for team dinner (6 ppl) Thurs night  which is best for groups?
Owen: Legal Harborside can handle groups and reserves. Row 34 is more bar-y  might be noisy for talking.
Lina: If you want something fancier, 'Scorpion Bar' at the Seaport Hotel has private-ish dining rooms. I booked there once for 8, no fuss.
Maya: Thanks! I'll try Legal Harborside for Thurs 7pm. Anyone mind if I ping the team to see who wants to join?
Harpreet: go for it. i'll probably swing by after 7:30.
SnackBot: Saved to travel notes: "BOS Seaport eats: Row 34 (oysters), Legal Harborside (group-friendly), Clover Food Lab (vegan quick), GreenHarbor (small plates), Scorpion Bar (private dining)". run `travel help bos seaport` to view hours and booking links.
Maya: Awesome, TY everyone :tada:
